label: Cleric Sun A
identity_view: front, front-right oblique, right profile, rear-right oblique, back in row-major order
description: The original tall adult male sun cleric in his exact ceremonial costume: a polished gold face mask with narrow dark eye openings and solemn sculpted mouth; thin uneven wavy gold sun rays project radially above and beside the head, preserving each native ray. Gray close-fitting head covering with dark horizontal straps is visible behind the mask. A stiff high scarlet collar flares beside the neck. A short broad gold-orange shoulder mantle hangs to the elbows and waist, with dense narrow flowing wavy gold ridges, divided at front and back by a narrow vertical red center opening. These are sculpted or embroidered wavy surfaces, not feathered wings. Long slim scarlet floor-length robe with alternating thin ochre-gold vertical stripes and heavy shaded folds; feet hidden. A narrow gold waist belt has a square turquoise-green central buckle. A long pointed dark teal-green front hanging stole has narrow gold edging and the exact native small gold square/dot ornaments. Bare tan forearms and empty tan hands, smooth pale gold wrist cuffs. Keep the native bright gold and scarlet colors, deep shadows, narrow body, long robe, exact sun-ray silhouette, cloth folds and hand gestures. No weapons, staff, shield, added ornaments, new symbols, halo, aura or glow. Only retain golden particles in native action/death cells that contain them; no particles in standing or walking. Palette variants affect only the teal front stole and matching buckle; protect all gold, scarlet cloth, skin and gray head covering.
